freeze_takes_effect: at the merge commit of the pull request that adds this file (issue #141, part 1)

amendment_rules.fields: path, op (modify | pin | unpin; default modify), kind, invalidates_row13_evidence, sha256_before (not for pin), sha256_after (not for unpin), and dr and/or ref (+ summary when only ref)
amendment_rules.isa-change: dr >= first_amending_dr required; ref alone refused
amendment_rules.conformance-fix: dr >= first_amending_dr required; ref alone refused
amendment_rules.no-behaviour-change: dr >= first_amending_dr, or ref ('#N' or 'owner/repo#N', form-checked only) with a non-empty summary; invalidates_row13_evidence must be false
amendment_rules.pin-set: pins, schema, record, freeze_base_commit and first_amending_dr never change after the first commit of this file; the pinned set changes only by an amendment with op pin or unpin, which needs dr >= first_amending_dr whatever its kind
amendment_rules.append-only: amendments already on the base ref are never edited or removed

pins.why: opcode table, encoding, timing model, register and pin-port model, program-memory size and serial load
fetch-ahead amendment to DR 0001's timing model: the fixed +1 cycle at run-phase entry
WCTL/RCTL control space, register map with per-index latency, the P1/P2 index-map note, pin modes, reset values, first-build points
firmware-visible boot interface: BOOT_STATUS bits, boot-ROM fetch until RUN, hand-over state, layer-1 PM_CRC readout
P1 (CRC/LFSR) and P2 (NRZI + bit stuffing) interface and index-map note; its tables define row 13's exclusions
SUB borrow polarity, SHF leaves Z, logic ops leave C, SHF fills with 0
the core: decode, datapath, flags, ports, WCTL/RCTL decode and registers, P1/P2 primitives, boot-ROM fetch select
program memory: serial load phase, PM_DATA port arbitration and its fixed stall, PM_CRC, BOOT_STATUS[0]
port-to-pin wiring of DR 0001's port table, UIO_DIR/UIO_OD pin-mode logic that makes uio_oe, load-phase CRC mux on uo_out
the assembly language as a programmer writes it: mnemonics, named control indices, encodings, reserved-encoding rules
the independent executable statement of the ISA that the lockstep bench grades the RTL against

amendments.summary: dated 2026-10-10 note recording the #166 ruling for #218 (loadseq refuses all-zero images, readout load roles moved to DR 0010); no RTL, timing or interface change

dated 2026-10-11 amendment superseding the timing model's 'fetch and execute happen in the same cycle' with DR 0005's fetch-ahead text (fixed +1 cycle at run-phase entry), which the frozen RTL already implements; DR 0005 is not bound; no RTL, timing or interface change

dated 2026-10-11 amendment superseding the port table's 'uio_oe direction is fixed at synthesis time' with DR 0012's run-time pin-mode text (UIO_DIR/UIO_OD, reset = all inputs), which the frozen RTL already implements; DR 0012 is not bound; no RTL, timing or interface change

dated 2026-10-11 entry: the UART boot frame gains a count-complement byte that the boot ROM checks before committing any word (F8 resolved); boot ROM firmware and host wire format only, no change to the ISA or to the pinned boot interface (BOOT_STATUS, ROM fetch until RUN, hand-over state, layer-1 PM_CRC readout)

RTL conformance fix to DR 0012's open-drain rule (register map row 0x01, 'Pin mode, per uio[n]'): an open-drain pin's pad data is tied to 0 (uio_out = core_uio_out & ~uio_od) and uio_oe alone carries the port-11 bit, so the pad cannot drive HIGH at any relative delay of the two nets; uio_oe is the same function of port 11, UIO_DIR and UIO_OD; no instruction, control index, latency, reset value or readback changes; row 13's WS2812 program drives uo_out only

LibreLane-flow-only (`ifdef __librelane__`) x4 buffer between each SRAM macro A_DOUT pin and instr_word, so a macro output always drives exactly one standard-cell input (the macro liberty's 64 fF max-capacitance limit); simulation and the klt/Yosys flow take the plain `assign instr_word = mem_dout`, a wire; no instruction, control index, latency, flag, reset value or readback changes, and a word appears on instr_word in the same cycle as before; plus the comment that says so

row13_excluded_protocols.rule: Row 13's primary protocol must not be any protocol named here. See DR 0017, 'Row 13: how the protocol is chosen'.
dr_0015: USB CRC5/CRC16 and low-speed USB TX/RX
RC-5 / RC-6 infrared, and Manchester/IR generally
isa_design_records: I2C target role and SPI target role as boot-ROM loads (DR 0013, Open items 2)
SPI / QSPI-Pmod flash read, command 0x03 (DR 0012, Context; DR 0013 layer 2)
